units.source_text: 然而，也不是所有的老师都欺负他。

en.t: However, not all of the teachers bullied him.

units.source_text: 他们之中，也曾有老师招待信辅参加家庭茶会，也有老师借给他英文小说。

en.t: Among them, there were also teachers who invited Shinsuke to family tea gatherings, and teachers who lent him English novels.

units.source_text: 他对四年级毕业时借来的一本《猎人笔记》的英译本记忆犹新，满心欢心的阅读完。

en.t: He vividly remembered an English translation of A Sportsman's Sketches that he borrowed when graduating from fourth year, and he read it through with great delight.

units.source_text: 但是，由于承担“教育责任”常常影响老师和普通人亲切来往。

en.t: But the burden of educational responsibility often interfered with warm relations between teachers and ordinary people.

units.source_text: 这是因为在接受他们示好的同时，还潜藏着某种对他们权力的卑微的奉承和讨好。

en.t: This was because, while accepting their kindness, there also lurked a certain humble flattery and currying of favor toward their authority.

units.source_text: 要不然，就是潜藏着对他们同性恋倾向的奉承丑态。

en.t: Or else there lurked the ugly spectacle of flattering their homosexual tendencies.

units.source_text: 信辅每次在他们面前出现的时候，总是感到受阻无所。

en.t: Whenever Shinsuke appeared before them, he always felt blocked and at a loss.

units.source_text: 不仅仅是这样，有时候还会不拘束的去拿香烟，或者显摆自己站着看戏的一些小事。

en.t: Not only that, sometimes he would go and take cigarettes without reserve, or show off about small things such as having watched a play while standing.

units.source_text: 他们自然把这种行为解释成傲慢。

en.t: Naturally, they interpreted this behavior as arrogance.

units.source_text: 这种解释也没什么问题。

en.t: There was nothing especially wrong with that interpretation either.

units.source_text: 本来他就不是个招人喜欢的学生。

en.t: After all, he was never a likable student to begin with.

units.source_text: 从放在箱子底部的旧照片来看，当时是他头很大，是个头和身体很不相称，但眼睛炯炯有神的病弱少年。

en.t: Judging from an old photograph kept at the bottom of a box, at that time he was a sickly boy with a large head out of proportion to his body, but with bright, piercing eyes.

units.source_text: 这个气色不好的病弱少年总是不停的提出刁钻问题，以为难老师为乐。

en.t: This pale, sickly boy was always asking tricky questions and taking pleasure in embarrassing his teachers.
